description: Source code implementing elliptic curve cryptography operations for P-256 curve using the BoringSSL library, including point addition, doubling, scalar multiplication, and modular inverse calculations, optimized for x86_64 and AARCH64 architectures.

methods.name: booth_recode_w5
methods.description: Recode window to a signed digit for 5-bit window, used in scalar recoding.

methods.name: booth_recode_w7
methods.description: Recode window to a signed digit for 7-bit window, used in scalar recoding.

methods.name: copy_conditional
methods.description: Conditionally copies source to destination based on move mask, used for constant-time operations.

methods.name: is_not_zero
methods.description: Checks if a BN_ULONG is non-zero, returns 1 if true, 0 otherwise.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_mod_inverse_sqr_mont
methods.description: Computes the modular inverse square in Montgomery domain for a given input.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_windowed_mul
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of a point with a scalar using windowed method.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_point_mul
methods.description: Multiplies a point by a scalar.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_point_mul_base
methods.description: Performs scalar multiplication of the generator point.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_points_mul_public
methods.description: Performs combined scalar multiplication for a public key and a point.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_get_affine
methods.description: Converts projective point to affine coordinates.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_inv0_mod_ord
methods.description: Computes the inverse of a scalar modulo the group order.

methods.name: ecp_nistz256_cmp_x_coordinate
methods.description: Compares the x-coordinate of a point with a scalar.
